balls.text: And the innings finishes as it deserved to - with a six! Low full toss on off, he gets low and flicks it over midwicket. 266 for 7!
Full on off, drilled straight down the ground. Long-off running across can't stop it and that's four! Shahbaz's first fifty in the IPL for him!

Low full toss on middle, chips it down the ground and they look to run two. Oops, Cummins has slipped at the striker's end as Shahbaz sprints down for the second. Cummins can't recover and he will have to walk back
Full around off, he goes for the flick and gets a top edge that flies over short third, who gives chase but in vain. Sunrisers get four more, and like they needed the good luck today!
Full on off, Cummins squeezes it out through mid-on to get Shahbaz on strike
Goes full and across Samad, who hits it straight to Nortje at cover who takes a good low catch. Muted celebrations as Samad walks
But the result is the same! It's in the slot around leg and Shahbaz flicks it square on the leg side and that brings up 250 for Sunrisers Hyderabad!
In the slot and put away! Shahabaz Ahmed goes over midwicket for a 76-metre six
Khaleel sees Samad go across the stumps and bowls it even wider. The ball bounces awkwardly in front of Pant and gets away from him as Sunrisers get a single
Stand and deliver! Full around off and he just clears his front leg and wallops it over cow corner
Slower ball on a length going across him. It dies on Samad as he swipes across the line
Back of length outside off, Shahbaz pulls it out to long-on

Bowls it superbly across him, forcing him to reach out and miss. Nailed the wide yorker there. Oops, that's being reviewed for wide. And that's crossed within the wide line, so Sunrisers lose all reviews!
Goes for the yorker, but it's a low full toss. Shahbaz jams his bat down and punches it out towards mid-off for a quick single
Full and he hits a crisp drive on the off side but straight to long-off
That's a full toss that Samad can't get a hold of as he looks to pull. Clears the midwicket fielder running back but only gets two
Samad crunnnnchhhhes his first ball through extra cover! Half-volley outside off, and Samad just hammers it flat in the gap for four
On a length around off, Shahbaz punches it out square on the off side to the deep fielder

Nitish goes for the big shot and perishes! Not exactly short and Nitish went for the pull. Gets it off the top half and it goes to David Warner and long-on. Kuldeep Yadav finishes with a four-fer, despite going for runs (who didn't today, really?)
Clipped through midwicket for a brace
Fast hands and what a reverse-scoop! Pant can only smile as Nitish lofts a length ball from Kuldeep over third with a wristy reverse-scoop
Googly on leg, Nitish hangs back and clips it out through towards long-on and they get a quick couple
Nitish wanted to come down the ground and Kuldeep throws it up across him and quite wide. Nitish pulls out of the shot anticipating a wide but it's not given
Kuldeep throws it full and wide, Shahbaz reaches out and slaps it away to deep cover
On a length around off, punched out to sweeper cover
Full outside off, pushed through cover to the fielder in the deep for a couple

Banged in short around leg and Shahbaz looks to hook and misses. And he reviews for a wide! That does look like it went over the helmet. The third umpire says Shahbaz was not standing upright and had he been, the ball would not have been above head height!

Almost a blinder from Axar backpedalling from midwicket! Nitish miscues a pull as Nortje goes short. It's just getting away from him. Axar sticks his right hand out, and gets his hand on the ball but can't hold it
Nitish goes down in pain! Swings and misses at a 145kph length ball that jags in to hit him on the box! Immediately goes down. He is getting treatment now
Length ball angled across Shahbaz, who opens his face to steer it fine on the off side. Good fielding by Khaleel running across from deep third to prevent the boundary
On a length outside off, slapped down the ground to long-off
Full on leg and that's a lovely flick-sweep over fine leg from Shahbaz!
Full outside off, he comes out of his crease and pushes it past the bowler to long-off
On a length, cut away to sweeper cover
Length ball angles in on leg from outside off, Nitish whips it away in front of square leg. Some good fielding by Abishek Porel in the deep means they can't get a second
Length ball across Shahbaz, who steers it towards point for a quick single
Almost gets the low full toss to sneak through but Nitish jams his bat down and gets an inside edge onto his pad
Full just around off at 120kph, tapped towards cover for a quick single
Mukesh now takes the pace off and Nitish waits on it and flicks it out to deep midwicket
Oh, shot! This is full outside off at around 140kph, Nitish uses the strength in his wrists to flick this over cow corner
Low full toss around off, driven out to long-off
Length ball outside off, Nitish punches it out to deep point
Tossed full on leg, flicked out to deep midwicket
Just short-ish and that's all Nitish needs to clear his front leg, rock back and pull it in the gap between deep square and deep midwicket
ON a length on leg, clipped leg side for a single
Full around off, clipped away to long-on
Short outside off, gets his cut to go through backward point
Darted in outside off, Nitish clips it through midwicket towards long-on
Length ball angles into Nitish, who clips it neatly through midwicket for a single
Pitched up, he hits a drive straight to cover
Length ball around off, steered towards backward point
Short and wide, Shahbaz stands tall and cuts it away hard and sweeper cover stood no chance
Length ball outside off, he opens the face to guide it to deep third
Stylish shot! Full outside off and he leans into an extra cover drive, high elbow and all. Holds the pose as the ball races away through the gap
Length ball steered to backward point
Full around off, swung away along the ground to long-on
Short on leg, going across Shahbaz, who scuffs a pull through midwicket
Length ball around off, clipped to Porel at midwicket. Nitish has to throw himself at the non-striker's end as the throw goes wide
Fires a short ball down leg
Slower ball on a length outside off, straightens after pitching. Reddy looks for the cut but can't connect
Full on middle, tucked to midwicket
Full on leg, clipped along the ground to deep midwicket. Sunrisers find themselves at 158 for 4 at the halfway stage of the innings
Quicker and flatter, angling into off, fended in front to the leg side
On a length around off, punched down the ground to long-on
Tossed full around leg, he sweeps it past short fine and gets off the mark
Length ball just outside off, clipped towards midwicket
Knocks Klaasen over! Axar bowls it on a length around off. It stays a little low as Klaasen looks to swing across the line and the ball crashes into the stumps. Two wickets in two balls for Capitals

Taken by Stubbs at long-on! Excellent, excellent catch there. Kuldeep bowls it on a length and Head goes back and looks to pull it down the ground. Does not get enough of it and Stubbs does well to run in a way and take that leaping forward. Kuldeep has his third and Head is denied a second IPL century in as many games
Head goes chasing after a wide legbreak outside off. And Kuldeep has bowled another wide here
Darts it in full on off at 114.5kph, Klaasen eases it out to long-off
Tossed up full outside off, but it's too wide
Slogged over deep midwicket! Tossed up full and that's in his arc. Klaasen gets in position early and belts it away
Looks to cut a length ball and misses. That was the wrong'un. Hold on, Capitals have reviewed! Did that nick the outside edge? It was close, but Ultraedge shows no spikes. Klaasen survives
And here's Klaasen! Gets one in the slot and he absolutely crunches it down the ground. 89 metres!
On a length around leg, punched out towards Kuldeep who can't collect. They get the single
Beaten! Looks to cut a length ball that pitches and turns away but swooshes at thin air!
Length ball angled across him, Head punches it out to long-off
Length ball angles in from outside off, he looks to block and gets an inside edge to the leg side
Full outside leg, Head skips out and drives it out to long-on
On a length and Klaasen cuts towards backward point and takes off for a tight single
Starts off with a length ball on off angling across Head, who pushes it out to sweeper cover

Kuldeep Yadav gets two wickets in an over! How often does he do this? Wrong'un on a length on off, Markram looks to slap it away but ends up giving Axar Patel an easy catch at cover. Kuldeep pumps his fists
Full on leg, driven out to cover
Looped up outside off, Head sweeps it along the ground to long-on
Tossed up on a length on the stumps, Markram punches it past the non-striker and gets off the mark

A blinder at cover and that's what it takes to stop this stunning assault! Full outside off, Abhishek looks to hammer it through cover but Axar throws himself low at it and holds on. Abhishek misses out on a much deserved half-century
On a length, Abhishek doesn't get to the pitch and is beaten in flight but he reaches out and goes through with the swing through the line. And that goes for a six down the ground

Full on leg, and Head casually lofts it over long-off to finish the powerplay with a six. 125 for 0 - the new highest powerplay score in all T20s! And that's the strategic time out, much needed for Capitals!
Mukesh with a rare dot ball as Head looks to go leg side but misses out

This is incredulous hitting! Nothing is working for Capitals! Goes for a yorker but Head is having none of it. Makes room and crunches this straight back and past Mukesh who couldn't react in time, it was hit that hard. And that's the biggest powerplay score in any T20!
Back of length outside off, same result as Head backs away and slaps it over cover! This is pure carnage! Head is on 74 off 23!
On a length outside off, Head stands tall and clubs it over mid-off!
Length ball outside off and Head backs away and slaps it away through cover! And that's the highest powerplay score in the IPL!
Sunrisers cross 100 in five overs! Kuldeep pulled his length back as he saw Abhishek advancing, and he doesn't get to the pitch of it, but he adjusts to muscle it over midwicket anyway!
Tossed full on leg, Head eases it through square leg for a single
Kuldeep bowls it on a length outside off, Head reaches for it but hits it into the ground
Full on leg, eased out to long-on for a single
Kuldeep errs in length and gets punished! Abhishek rocks back and pulls this short one away over deep square!
Abhishek greets him with disdain! Skips down the track as Kuldeep tosses it up full on leg. Lofts it high over long-on for a 74-metre six
Battered down the ground Short-ish and Head has to swivel as he slaps it down the ground
Tossed wide of off, Abhishek again looks for a big shot and gets an inside edge through the leg side
Dances down the track and smokes it over long-on! Length ball outside off, Abhishek adjusts and swings it away
Pitched full around leg, Head punches it back down the ground but Lalit can't stop it and Sunrisers get the single away
On a length on leg, Abhishek looks to swing it away but can only get it off his pads to short fine leg
Abhishek wants to be in on the action too! Absolute half-tracker and Abhishek rocks back and pulls it high over deep midwicket
Travis Head gets his half-century and it's only the third over! Head equals Abhishek for SRH's fastest fifty! It's short on middle and leg and Head swings it over deep square
This is full on leg, Head goes leg side of the ball and opens the face to steer it fine on the off side. Another four
Clubbed in the gap between midwicket and mid-on and SRH have their team fifty up in 16 balls!
Nortje bumps it in short outside leg and Head ducks
Head goes for a big swing away and this time he gets an inside edge that dribbles down fine leg. It's all happening for SRH now
Head greets him with a lob back over his head! This is full on middle and leg, Head moves leg side and meets it with a straight bat
Goes hiiiiigh in the air and drops just short of the boundary rope for a one-bounce four. This was flung full outside off, Abhishek got to the pitch of it and went inside out over cover
Tossed up full, flicked away along the ground to deep midwicket
Poor fielding and it costs Capitals four more. Short-ish outside off, Head cuts it hard to point where Nortje lets it go through him
Tossed up full on middle and leg, Head parries it back to the bowler
Head goes boom boom! Another drag-down and this time Head deposits even further over deep midwicket
Belted over cow corner! Dragged down around off and Head rocks back and swings it away
Just helped fine! Length ball angling down leg, Abhishek just whips it off his hips through fine leg. And that's 19 runs off the first over

Khaleel goes for a yorker on leg. Head tries to flick it on but it pops to the off side off his pad. Khaleel was up in appeal but the umpire not interested. Looked like that was going down leg. Could have been an inside edge too

One-bounce four! Head has decided to tear into Khaleel right from the first over! Back of length delivery and this time Head doesn't quite get underneath it with the pull, so it doesn't go all the way, but the fielders had no chance!
Now slapped away through point! On a length outside off, and that's too much width on offer as Head cashes in. That was hit hard
Head's caught a hold of that! Khaleel digs it in back of a good length Head frees his arms and fetches it from outside off and deposits it over deep midwicket
Starts off with a back of length delivery outside off, it seams away after pitching. Head goes after it but can't connect

Goes to hook and finds the long leg fielder and that's wrapped up for Sunrisers Hyderabad! Short ball angled into him, Pant tried to get in the line and help it along but there was no pace for him to play with
Length ball angling across Mukesh, who pats it down on the off side
Goes for a yorker on middle, turns into a low full toss. Mukesh is able to keep it out

yorker searing into his toes. Kuldeep misses the flick, and it hits his boot. Umpire swift to raise his finger for the LBW and Kuldeep reviews. Replay shows three reds - crashing into leg stump. And that is also Natarajan's best figures in T20 cricket!
cleans him up! Full ball on middle. Nortje tries to swing across the line but he's beaten by the quicker delivery at almost 139kph.
yorker length just outside leg and dug away back to the bowler
knee-high full toss just outside off. Axar tries to get under it and lift it over cover, but fails to clear Cummins at cover. A second wicket for Natarajan

audacious shot over extra cover! Short ball around off but angling into Pant. He plays an inside-out flat-batted shot that is smashed over the fielder at cover. Contorts his body in such a way that he could get the direction as desired
boundary dribbled away to fine leg with Pant moving across the line and clipping a shot off his waist. This was a length ball that was angling into his hip
full ball on middle, but rolls his fingers over this delivery. Tries to smack it leg side but it is inside edged onto his body
yorker length, around leg. Squirts a shot away to the leg side for one
back of a length slower ball on off and middle. Pant swipes a pull but misses altogether.
around the stumps to Axar. Length ball angling into the batter. Axar plays a high-elbow loft over Pant to long on
low full toss on off and he hammers a drive past the bowler. But long off is present on the line
full ball on middle and off. Opens the bat's face and jams a shot towards cover point
full ball just outside leg. Tries to flick. Hits his boot and goes to Klaasen who dives to grab the ball. Appeals for caught-behind and Axar is ball-watching. Pant calls him through for a run
full ball, but lands it wide outside off. Pant gets down on one knee before hammering a shot over the non-striker. But long off runs around and stops that
fullish ball outside off. Pant throws his body into the shot, losing his shape and ending up on only one leg as he clatters a cut behind square for four
shin-high full toss as he misses the yorker. Toe-ends a gentle shot towards long on for one
back of a length slower ball on middle. Axar gets cramped but attempts a pull anyway. Mistimed to the leg side
short ball on leg. Pant moves further outside leg before flat-batting from near his head to mid on
there it is, finally! Slot ball on middle, and Pant launches a six over cow corner! Opened his stance towards midwicket before tonking it away into the stands
yorker length ball on middle and off stump. Flicked off his toes to deep midwicket
short ball at 121kph, and Pant moves across to play a pull but it goes over his head
good length ball outside off stump. Pushed to deep point for a single
around the stumps to Pant. Bowls a good length ball outside off and Pant swings across the line to drag a shot to deep midwicket

cranks the pace up to 138kph and smashes Lalit's leg stump. Full ball just outside leg stump but angling into the stumps. Lalit makes room and tries to hit a shot through mid off but the ball goes past his outside edge and then lights up the poles
back of a length slower ball that angles away from Lalit. He swings across the line, losing his shape totally, and only finds air
yorker length ball, angling away from Lalit. Tries to dig it out, and ends up getting a thick edge past the keeper's right for four
short ball on off. Pace off again. Pant pulls to backward deep square leg

full ball, wide outside off, forcing Pant to reach out. But he manages to hit a shot well enough to clear cover's right. Nitish at deep point hares around the boundary line to stop a four at deep extra cover
strike-rate drops under 80 after that dot. Overpitched ball just outside off and Pant toe-ends a muscled shot back to the bowler

full and wide delivery outside off. Lalit tries to play away from his body but misses. Wide given but Cummins asks for a wide review. The replay shows the ball is inside the wide guide-line, just inside in fact, and the umpire will have to declare that a fair ball

good length ball just outside off. Slower ball too. Pant swivels to pull to the leg side but he is deceived by the 115kph ball. Through the shot too early and the ball hits his body after kissing his glove. One run only
Pant is struggling tonight as he misses another experimental shot. Tries to play a reverse ramp over short third, but the pace of the delivery beats him.
Pant backs away exposing all three stumps. Cummins bowls full on a fifth-stump line. Ball whizzes through to the keeper with Pant offering no shot
around the wicket. Slower ball bouncer on off-stump. Pant moves to the off side to try and swipe a shot over short fine leg but falls over onto the floor
full ball on middle and leg, angling into Lalit with the angle of release. Nurdled to mid on for a single
a four-run over and a wicket. Length ball angling in, and he swipes across the line to hit the shot to deep backward square leg
rolls his fingers over this ball. Length ball outside off and pushed towards cover. Cummins intecepts
back of a length ball on middle, and he mistimes a flat-batted shot to long on. Pant not getting his connections unless he gets a full toss
good length ball just outside off. Tapped to cover for a quick single
short ball, banged in. Stubbs tries to maul a pull over cow corner but the lack of pace means Stubbs can't generate a lot of power off the bat. Mistimed, and straight to short midwicket
back of a length ball on middle from Nitish, the medium-pacer. Cut uncomfortably to deep point
Pant charges at Bhuvneshwar, but the bowler bowls a length ball outside leg, cramping up the batter as he runs down the track. Mistimed bunt to the off side and they scurry across for a single
another full toss, knee-high this time, and Pant uses his wrists to flick a well-timed shot behind the fielder at deep backward square leg!

chance of a run out! But nope - safe! Tries to go across to the off side to play a shot over fine leg but it hits his body and goes to the off side. Pant is not interested in a single, but Stubbs is, and he is forced to turn back after running halfway down
good length ball around middle and off. Pace off. Bunted to cover after being deceived
first boundary of the night for Rishabh Pant! Low full toss on his heels, and Pant uses his wrists to flick it beautifully behind square!
full ball on leg stump. Stubbs misses the flick and it rattles him on his shin. No LBW appeal since this would've missed leg stump
short ball around leg stump. Pulled to deep square leg. Short ball again
short ball on off. Pace off again. Pant pulls in the gap behind square but the fielder on the line - Washington - puts in a solid effort with a run and dive to keep it down to one
full ball on middle and driven to long off for a single
full ball just outside off. Guided to deep third for a single
short ball outside off. Pant tries to climb on top of the ball to flat-bat it down the ground for four. But he ends up hitting it onto the pitch, and Natarajan collects
mixes it up with a bouncer. Slower ball too. Mistimed pull goes behind for one

yorker length, fifth-stump line. Gets the bat down to try and guide it to deep third but ends up hitting it right to Markande at point. Fielder is interested for a catch but he's not very sure if it is a bump-catch or fair catch. The umpires opt to take the review, not the fielding side, and replay confirms that it is a bump-ball catch
fullish ball on middle and he caresses a drive to long on for a jogging single
test-match length, just outside off. Stands tall and fends from near his chest
short ball on middle. Pace off. Swivels and pulls to fine leg for a single
a dot from Cummins. Back of a length and tapped back to the bowler
around the stumps to Rishabh. Full around off and driven back towards the bowler
faster one. Full around off. Pant punches off the back foot to the off side
full ball around middle and off. Turning away. Played to cover with the turn

outwits Porel and gets him stumped. Porel was coming down the track a lot, and this time Markande acts on that impulse. Bowls a full ball very wide outside off, and Klaasen was ready for that line. Swiftly collected well outside off, and he cleans up the stumps thereafter
good length ball around off. Googly turning in. Flat-batted to long on but only for one
full ball outside off. Googly turns further away. Reaches out and cuts to the deep for a single
good length ball on off stump, and he drills a punch to long off for one
hit towards the off side
finds the gap on the leg side! Swivels to this length ball and ensures he pummels a shot in front of square, beating the outfielder!
good length ball just outside off. Turning away and he tries to punch it down the ground. Takes an outside edge and goes to deep third
full toss on the leg stump with Porel charging again. Flicked to deep square leg
skips down the track and then lambasts Shahbaz over cow corner! Gets to the pitch of the ball and lifts his back leg while hitting the shot. Great sight
pierces the gap! Length ball angling across the left-hander, and he opens the bat's face late before cutting it between short third and point
Shahbaz around the stumps to his Bengal teammate. Flat ball, full and wide, and the cut is hit well past the diving Cummins at point!

party over and the wristspinner gets the wicket. Full, wider outside off. Jake tries to club him over cover again but he ends up slicing it. False shot, and Klaasen with the gloves calls for a catch. He runs across towards point and then slides to complete the dismissal. A stunning innings - now over
best of the over! Markande bowls full on middle and leg, but Jake spots the line, clears the front leg, and then hits an inside-out maximum over wide long off!
full ball, wider outside off. Turning away. Misses the cut
celebrates the fifty with another six! Tossed up outside off. Enough pace and room for Jake to pounce onto that. Pastes Markande over long off. The googly gets the same treatment
a 15-ball fifty for young Jake Fraser-McGurk! This was full on off and he hangs back, letting the ball get to him before shellacking a six over Markande. That's faster than even Head's fifty!
full ball, tossed up wider outside off. Comes down the track and hits it down to Markram at long on
full ball outside off and driven to deep extra cover
slower ball bouncer on off. Porel hangs back and pulls along the ground to deep midwicket. A tidy sixth over to end the powerplay at 88 for 2. Also a time out.
low full toss around leg stump. Porel mistimes a shot to mid on
back of a length slower ball around off. Porel moved to the off side and tried to play a swipe or ramp over short fine leg, but he is deceived by the pace-off delivery

back to regular transmission! Mows a boundary over midwicket this time. Attempts a full ball and lands it outside leg to cramp Porel. But Porel does even better by moving wide outside leg stump, thus getting in good position for the shot

slower ball bouncer, which Porel tries to attack by attempting a pull. Misses, and it also goes down the leg side. Soft appeal for caught behind by the bowler but I suspect that's him trying to avoid a wide-run
two dots in a row! Nearly the perfect yorker and Porel got low to try and guide a shot past short third. But stopped inside the circle
full ball around off and Porel over-hits this ball, trying to pull in front of square, but ending up mis-hitting to midwicket
no respect for the attempted slower ball. Lands in the slot outside off and Jake gets very low before launching a slog over long on for half a dozen!
reaches 40 in 12! Full ball on middle, and he makes room before getting the bat down and drilling a four through cover and cover point! Fifty stand in 17 balls
slower ball yorker attempted. Lands just outside off. Mistimed to deep extra cover
that's a good looking shot through the off side! Stylishly runs down the track, staying leg side of the stumps, and then clatters a lofted drive over cover with Cummins bowling outside off

laced away! Like a tracer bullet. Good length ball on middle and off. Not a lot of room but enough for Porel, who times it gloriously off the bat, cutting it behind square. Man in the deep did try to cut it off but failed
full ball around leg stump, and Jake cannot flick it well off his heel. Mistimed to the leg side for a single
again overpitched, searching for the yorker, and Porel cannot get the bat swing right to hit him down the ground. Mistimed to the bowler's left, who intercepts with one hand
fuller, almost a yorker, and Porel toe-ends a mistimed shot towards Bhuvneshwar
crowd goes "oooh" as Porel tries to run to the off side and play a ramp over the leg side. But he misses and he's lucky the bails are still on the poles
terrific drive! Not full, just on a good length but the tall man Porel just commits to the off-side drive, and he walks into the shot, sending it through the covers
good length ball outside leg. Porel comes down the track and mistimes the swipe on the leg side
rarity as we get a dot. Good length ball on middle, and snaking across Porel as he tries to poke at it. To the keeper

dropped! By the person the stands. Faster one from Washington, trying to cramp and hurry Jake up with a length ball skidding onto him from middle stump. But Jake shuffles behind and then uses his quick hands to manufacture a shot that sends Washington over long off again!
half-tracker on off and angling across. Once again Jake gets width, and he doesn't need a second invite. Goes deep in his crease, clears the front leg, and flat-bats a six over long off
good length ball just outside off. Jake keeps a steady head before clattering a cut between mid off and cover!
even better! Full ball, slower through the air, but Jake stays in his crease, doesn't commit too early, and muscles a six over Washington's head!
scythed over mid off! Another good length ball outside off. Jake stands tall before using his power to get it over the infielder
hammered over cover! Good length ball, significantly wide outside off, and Jake stands tall before clubbing it for four

spooned to mid off! Cross-seamed delivery, landing on a good length on off. Ball takes some spongy bounce and surprises Warner as he tries to play a punchy shot. Hits the top-half of his bat and it pops up for a diving Cummins at mid off
good length ball on middle and angling across. The cut does not beat point
full ball just outside off. Jake tries to play a drive to mid off but the ball takes an inside edge. Lands a few metres short of the diving short-third fielder
cut in front of square! Width offered, not full, and he slaps it through the covers for another boundary
big swing but finds air. Not full enough for Jake to attempt a loft over mid on with minimal footwork. Through to the keeper as he misses it altogether
fuller, on the stumps. Warner taps it gently to the off side for a single
again this goes down the leg side for wide. Good length delivery just outside leg
good length ball outside leg stump. Again swinging further down. Bhuvneshwar trying to cramp Warner early on
fullish ball just outside leg stump, and going down the leg side. Starts off with a wide
good length ball just outside off and skidding through. Tries to cut but misses

Shaw is gone! Washington tosses it on middle stump. Shaw looks to go inside out over cover, but he's sliced it to Samad at cover. A short-and-sweet innings but Capitals needed so much more tonight from Shaw
good length ball on off and angling across. Shaw stays leg side of the ball and mauls a cut through the off side!
